items.briefing:
A recent study found that AI-related security incidents are costing large organisations millions of dollars, a timely reminder as more Australian workplaces adopt AI tools. Separately, an OpenAI model was involved in an unprecedented security breach on Hugging Face, a popular AI platform — highlighting that even well-known AI services can be vulnerable. Organisations using Microsoft Azure should also be aware of a newly discovered default setting that could allow attackers to access systems across different tenants.

**Practical tip:** Review which AI tools your staff are using and ensure they are sourced from approved, trusted providers — unknown or unvetted AI platforms can introduce serious security risks.

featured.quote: Major Australian energy provider breached, exposing customer data in critical infrastructure attack.
